summary: Tested KYC detailed feedback and manual review features for BidBlitz Super-App. Backend APIs working correctly. Frontend UI elements present and functional.
seed_data_creation: Created test users for KYC testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: KYC detailed feedback and manual review features are working. Key test data-testids: kyc-detailed-feedback-card, kyc-feedback-item-*, kyc-manual-review-card, kyc-request-manual-review-button, admin-detail-kyc, admin-kyc-approve-*, admin-kyc-reject-*, admin-kyc-feedback-*

kyc_status_endpoint_returns_detailed_fie.details: GET /api/kyc/status returns kyc_status, failure_reasons, user_feedback, failed_attempts, can_request_manual_review, manual_review_requested

german_issue_message_mapping.details: ISSUE_MESSAGE_MAP in kyc.py contains 30+ German messages for specific issues like front_too_high, front_too_low, front_cropped, front_blurry, front_dark, etc.

manual_review_threshold.details: MANUAL_REVIEW_THRESHOLD = 2. can_request_manual_review becomes True when failed_attempts >= 2 and manual_review_requested is False

manual_review_request_endpoint.details: POST /api/kyc/manual-review/request works correctly. Returns 400 if not rejected or failed_attempts < 2

admin_kyc_list_endpoint.details: GET /api/kyc/admin/list?status=pending returns pending KYC reviews with user_feedback and failed_attempts

admin_kyc_decision_endpoint.details: POST /api/admin/customers/{user_id}/kyc allows admin to approve/reject KYC

frontend_verification_page.details: VerificationPage.jsx shows kyc-detailed-feedback-card with user_feedback items, kyc-manual-review-card with failed attempts count, and kyc-request-manual-review-button when eligible

frontend_admin_kyc_panel.details: AdminDetailRouter.jsx KycDetail shows failed_attempts, manual_review_requested status, user_feedback in 'Konkret erkannte Probleme' section, and Freischalten/Ablehnen buttons

test_mode_behavior.details: TEST_MODE allows features (can_use_features returns True for all) but kyc_status still reflects actual internal status

frontend_tests.admin_panel_kyc: Verified KYC-Freischaltung panel shows 12 pending KYC applications with Freischalten/Ablehnen buttons
frontend_tests.verification_page: Verified /verification route loads VerificationPage with kyc-status-actions-card
